proposal_origin: AI-authored engineering change proposal during this development session; fixture reviewed before execution
request: Increase the roller outside diameter by 2 mm. Preserve the declared radial clearance to the curved seat, keep the tooth-root datum tied to the outer seat envelope, retain the smooth core beneath the textured bands, and do not change the roller's rotational axis or joint semantics.
rationale: A 2 mm increase in outside diameter increases roller radius by 1 mm.
The seat radius is derived from roller radius plus the declared 0.5 mm radial clearance, so it also moves outward by 1 mm.
The outer curved-wall radius follows the seat radius plus wall thickness; the tooth-root datum must therefore move outward by 1 mm to preserve its declared relationship.
The roller core diameter remains unchanged at 22.6 mm and stays below the new 26 mm outside diameter.
The roller axis and continuous +X joint are unchanged.
expected_invariants: tooth_root_z equals roller_axis_z minus outer_wall_radius minus tooth_height
roller_rotation remains a continuous joint on +X
evidence_boundary: This change is a parametric software test, not a measured Nyfasi product modification. All affected dimensions remain research assumptions or patent-derived estimates.
